messages:
From: Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@fintechapp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: New mobile product — expected usage profile + pricing question

Hi Marcus / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're planning to add an in-app assistant to our mobile wallet (Q4 launch) that will do short-form chat for transaction help and proactive spend insights. Early product forecasts attached (fintech_forecast_aug24.csv).

High-level expected profile (monthly):
- Active users sending ~3 queries/day (avg 20 tokens per response)
- Peak events: marketing pushes that spike QPS for 1-2 hour windows (x6-8 baseline)
- Starting monthly tokens ~120M, expected to grow to ~450M over 6 months if adoption tracks

We want to understand:
1) For hosted API usage-based pricing, do you offer a separate per-token discount band for add-on workloads tied to a dedicated commit, or is this handled as top-up credits on current commit tiers?
2) Can we combine a small committed monthly volume (e.g., 200M tokens) with a burst bucket for unpredictable marketing spikes, and how are overage rates calculated?
3) Any surcharge for low-latency routing / mobile edge inference?

We need a clear example quote we can show procurement (incl. any one-time onboarding or enablement fees). Aim to get a formal quote by next week if possible.

Thanks — Sasha
Sasha Reed
Head of Product Partnerships
FintechApp Inc.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Sasha — thanks for the forecast and the clear callouts, helpful context. Below is a concise framework and an example seat-of-the-pants quote so you have something to show procurement quickly.

Quick framework (options we typically use for add-on workloads):
- Incremental commit + tiered per-token: You purchase a committed monthly token amount (e.g., 200M) with stepped per-token pricing that improves with larger commits. Committed usage is invoiced monthly and consumes first.
- Burst bucket (optional): A prepaid burst bucket that sits outside the commit for short spikes. Priced at a modest premium to committed-per-token but lower than on-demand overage rates. Useful for marketing events.
- On-demand overage: If you exceed commit + burst, overage is billed at a clearly stated per-token rate. We can cap overage exposure with soft limits and alerts.
- Low-latency routing: If you require guaranteed <60ms P95 routing to a mobile-edge region, we add a fixed per-token routing uplift (typically ~5-8% on per-token). Can be waived if you accept regional best-effort routing.

Example starting quote (illustrative):
- Committed monthly: 200,000,000 tokens at $0.0009/token = $180,000/mo
- Burst bucket: 50,000,000 tokens prepaid at $0.0011/token = $55,000 one-time (refillable)
- Overage: $0.0016/token beyond commit + burst
- Low-latency routing uplift: +6% on per-token charges (commit and burst) if required
- One-time onboarding & compliance review fee: $7,500 (covers SSO/KMS review + initial traffic shaping)

Notes: We can structure a stepped discount if you commit > 500M tokens/month; that moves the committed per-token to ~$0.00075. We can also put a 6-month introductory runway with the first-month credits to smooth procurement approvals.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Sasha: confirm preferred commit floor (e.g., 200M vs 300M) and whether you want a prepaid burst bucket.
2) Ben / Marcus: we'll draft a formal quote + MSA addendum and share the DocuSign link.
3) Procurement: FintechApp to share billing contact and PO workflow.

I'm attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (mutual_action_plan_v3.xlsx) with milestones and a sample timeline. Will follow up with Ben to pull finance details.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
